entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Precompiled query with shadow property name that contains invalid characters fails to compile #38432

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38435
  • Add DATA_COMPRESSION support for primary keys and unique constraints #38434
    community-contribution
  • Honor explicit store type when discovering Dictionary<string,object> #38433
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/10.0] Guard EF file generation during commandline builds to fix AOT build fork bomb #38403
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.10
  • [release/10.0] Fix 'ordinal -1 is invalid' crash when a nested JSON complex sub-collection grows #38373
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.10
  • Use null propagation to optimize away `IS NOT NULL` checks #34127
    community-contribution
  • Switch Microsoft.Data.Sqlite and EFCore.Sqlite to SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle #38402
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38431
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38422
  • Update CODEOWNERS to add Will to more files #38421
  • Bump dotnet/arcade/.github/workflows/inter-branch-merge-base.yml from 67a6a00138b6c09d76a2f96bf4cf8b91b55fc52a to a6bacc00545c78b35c459f81331508e43d835d23 #38414
    area-infrastructure

Updated

  • Avoid reflective default key comparer creation in compiled models (NativeAOT) #38427
  • Fix compiled model CreateRelationalModel() failure with owned entity sharing owner's table #38428
  • Add Half type support for SQLite (#30931) #37481
    community-contribution
  • Use string type mapping when sending null values for JSON column update on SQL Server #38426
  • Allow runtime constants in precompiled queries #38430
    community-contribution
